finding: The revised direct-CUPTI helper finalized cleanly for one vLLM request, but wrote 167979670 bytes and 357787 records before the server stopped. Only 100455786 bytes remained under the approved 268435456-byte nominal output bound. The approved full workload has 200 warmup and 2200 measured requests, so this one-request smoke does not qualify its capture capacity.

proposed_change.encoding: Write a lossless streaming compressed record stream instead of raw NDJSON; pin the codec, version, framing, and revised helper source and binary hashes before final observations.
proposed_change.bound_semantics: Apply the existing 268435456-byte nominal and 65536-byte W4 output limits to compressed bytes physically written by each helper. This is a changed interpretation of output_byte_bound and needs explicit approval even though the numeric values are unchanged.
proposed_change.verification: Decode every finalized stream to the canonical NDJSON records, hash the decoded bytes, compare decoded record counts with helper counters, validate framing and EOF, and require zero reported CUPTI and local drops in nominal trials. Corruption, bound exhaustion, missing status, or count mismatch is partial or failed, never silently accepted.
proposed_change.timing: Keep the approved request workload and measurement window. The compressor and its control thread run inside the measured profiled process, so their latency, CPU, and memory overhead remains charged to the mode.
proposed_change.w4: Retain all five approved one-intervention variants. The 65536-byte output-limit variant must demonstrably induce and report truncation under the new encoded-byte interpretation; otherwise record unsupported.
proposed_change.failure_preservation: Retain partial encoded streams, decode errors, status files, stop acknowledgments, exits, raw logs, and all failed attempts. Never infer zero loss from a failed decode.

required_validation_before_final_observa: CPU tests for multi-process isolation, encoded-byte bounds, truncation, corrupt frames, missing stop acknowledgment, timeout, nonzero exits, and partial retention
a bounded one-request L4 smoke comparing decoded records with the retained uncompressed capture and confirming a finalized zero-drop status
bounded nominal and each approved W4 control smoke, with source and binary hashes recorded
GPU, pinned host, and collector-buffer memory accounting, trusted Nsight correlation and coverage, and packaging/privilege checks
explicit approval of this capture-format amendment and revised helper hashes
separate explicit final-run authorization only after hardware preflight passes
if_not_approved: Keep the frozen raw NDJSON output bound; mark direct-CUPTI capacity unverified and any overflow as failed or partial. Do not run final trials or claim an adoption result.
